eli-docs: Quick heads-up — I'm about to open a cleanup PR for the Error Reference page: consolidating the 429, timeout, and context-limit examples, and fixing a couple of broken links. Need a couple reviewers for SDK snippets (Go + Python) and the new retry examples.
sam-ops: +1, I can take the Go snippets. Any specific behavior changes we need to call out for Dedicated vs Hosted?
eli-docs: Good Q — please call out that Dedicated has higher burst capacity and different throttling thresholds; add a short note to each 429 example: "thresholds vary by deployment mode" and link to the capacity table.
nina: I found one broken link in the embedding section that points to an old gist. I'll paste the link after I open the PR. Also spotted an outdated curl snippet that uses the v1/old-route.
maria: For the timeout section, can we add a minimal client-side backoff snippet? Something we can drop into the SDK examples. Prefer 3 retries with exponential backoff and jitter.
eli-docs: Yes — adding a compact snippet. Draft I plan to include:
```
# python example (requests)
for attempt in range(3):
    try:
        resp = session.post(url, json=payload, timeout=5)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        break
    except requests.exceptions.Timeout:
        sleep((2 ** attempt) + random.random())
```
sam-ops: That looks good. For Go I'll mirror the behavior (context with timeout + small backoff). I'll also add a note about idempotency for retries when the request may have side effects.
eli-docs: Nice, add a short sentence: "Only retry idempotent operations or ensure server-side dedupe".
devex-bot: Reminder: docs PR templates require a short changelog line and the screenshots checklist.
eli-docs: Thanks — will add changelog. Also need help verifying the SDK snippet outputs in CI examples (we show expected error strings for 429 and the timeout message). Maria, can you run the snippet and paste the exact error text?
maria: On it. Running the Python snippet now, will paste output in a follow-up comment.
(10m later) maria: Python snippet produces: "requests.exceptions.ReadTimeout: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='api.redwood.ai', port=443): Read timed out." — I'll include that exact text in the doc so the troubleshooting table matches logs.
eli-docs: Perfect. Nina — can you drop the corrected embedding link here and note the old gist ID to be removed?
nina: Old gist: gist.github.com/old-embed-42, new link: https://github.com/redwood/embeddings#best-practices. I'll add both to the PR description for traceability.
sam-ops: One more edge-case: context trimming guidance — add a tiny note and sample pseudocode showing how to trim system prompts vs user content, and warn about semantic changes if you truncate system instructions.
eli-docs: Agreed. I'll add pseudocode and call out that trimming system messages is last-resort.
deploy-bot: deploy-preview created for branch error-ref/cleanup-429-120s — preview URL: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr/4321
eli-docs: Thanks — reviewers please check that the Go/Python snippets compile and that the preview renders the new table. If no major issues I'll merge by EOD. :thumbsup:
maria: quick lgtm once CI passes.
sam-ops: lgtm pending a tiny wording tweak in the Dedicated note.
nina: lgtm for links.
eli-docs: Thanks all — I'll address wording tweak and merge after CI. If anyone wants to add test prompts for the regression suite, drop them here.
